propositions: prev_snapshot.json consumes 228.1 MB total (4.5 MB/day growth) by storing full ACLI payloads instead of only Jira key sets, making it the largest contributor to state storage after A1

Empirical corpus testing over 4 real snapshot pairs shows zero observable difference in Jira-reaching mutations when prev_snapshot is narrowed from full payloads to {jira_key: {}} key-set shape, validating that drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions call-site filter prevents unintended side effects

Branch-2 regression: with >=900 prev-only keys in full payload form, compute_mutations emits 973–998 unbound_local create mutations that the call-site filter must suppress; key-set shape eliminates these wasted emissions at source without changing Jira-facing behavior

After cutover, prev_snapshot at HEAD measures 19,960 bytes (key-set) versus 27.1 MB (full payload), and over 400 real revisions 218 consecutive pairs have identical key sets (byte-identical, zero commits), with mean symmetric difference of 1.78 keys when they differ

Reverse-direction corpus diff (key-set → full revert path) and forward diff both show zero unexpected inbound creates and zero observable mutation differences, confirming safe rollback capability without requiring full-payload deletion
